Subject: LumenBio pilot — request for a short-term bridge credit

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked promising and the team is excited to move to a short pilot. We have one internal constraint before we can sign: we need a modest onboarding credit to cover unexpected token usage during integration (the pilot will initially spike while they tune prompts and evaluate end-to-end flows).

High-level ask: a one-time bridge credit equal to $18k (to be applied against the first invoice) and temporary removal of the 30k monthly min for the first 60 days so we can ramp without overcommitment. We’re happy to sign a 9-month pilot SOW once we confirm those terms.

Attached: LumenBio_SOW_v1.pdf (draft).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve a one-time packaging/credit concession, or whether you need a VP/CFO sign-off?

Thanks,
Beth

Hi Beth — great to meet you yesterday. Appreciate the clear ask and the draft SOW.

Quick read-through: the pilot looks standard and there’s a good chance we convert to a paid customer after ramp. That said, the one-time $18k credit + min-waiver is outside of my standard AE concession band, so I’ll need Marissa and RevOps to weigh in for an exec approval.

Proposed path: I’ll put together a short internal memo with the conversion probability and recommended offset (we typically ask for a 35% discount ceiling or a matching onboarding marketing offset). If LumenBio can commit to a 9-month ARR target in the SOW (milestone-based), we can present a structured bridge:
- One-time credit: $18,000 applied to first invoice
- 60-day min-waiver for the 30k floor
- Conditional rollback: credit recovered as bill credits if no committed conversion by month 4

Can you confirm the conversion milestone that LumenBio is comfortable including (monthly active endpoints or production users)? Also attaching preliminary pricing worksheet for internal review (lumen_pricing_model_v3.xlsx).

I’ll loop Marissa and Aditya for sign-off.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Monica / Aditya —

Looping in as requested. Quick take: LumenBio looks like a strategic vertical account in diagnostics; probability of conversion post-pilot is moderate-high based on use case. Approving $18k as a one-time onboarding credit is acceptable provided we get:
1) Signed 9-month SOW with explicit conversion milestones (monthly endpoints >= 3 and production usage test by day 45)
2) Clause that allows us to claw back the credit pro-rata if milestones not met by month 4
3) Legal sign-off on the SOW language (no unilateral termination within the first 60 days)

Please prepare a one-page exec memo (bullet format) with the recommended concession, expected ARR uplift, downside risk, and an ask for VP/CFO sign-off. I can provide the final approval if the dollar impact is <= $20k. If the net present value or risk profile is larger, we’ll need CFO sign-off.
